mainEntity.name: What is an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU)?

acceptedAnswer.text: An ADU is a secondary residential unit on the same lot as a primary single-family home, providing complete independent living facilities including kitchen, bathroom, sleeping, and living areas.
